label: VF / VFL-like pattern
description: Chaotic, high-frequency oscillation with no discernible QRS-T structure.

label: TdP-like pattern
description: Polymorphic QRS complexes with a twisting amplitude envelope.

label: VT-like pattern
description: Fast, wide-QRS regular rhythm with reduced RR variability.

label: Irregular ectopic-like pattern
description: Irregular rhythm with occasional ectopic-like spikes.

label: Supraventricular-like pattern
description: Narrow, regular QRS complexes at an elevated rate, abnormal P-wave timing.

label: Sinus-like pattern
description: Regular QRS complexes at a normal rate with stable RR intervals.
